cards.title: 确认团队分工
cards.description_en: A developer confirms who owns and maintains each service with a teammate.
cards.description_zh: 开发者与同事确认各项服务由谁负责和维护。
cards.communication_goal: 确认服务责任归属与维护分工。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Who has ownership of the billing service?
dialogue.zh: 账单服务由谁负责？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Maya does. Her main responsibility is keeping it reliable.
dialogue.zh: 由 Maya 负责。她的主要职责是保证它稳定运行。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: And who will maintain the new reporting module?
dialogue.zh: 那新的报表模块由谁来维护？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I will. Let's add both names to the board.
dialogue.zh: 我来维护。我们把这两个名字都加到白板上吧。

cards.scene_prompt: Two adult stick-figure coworkers stand to the LEFT and center of a freestanding rectangular whiteboard on the RIGHT. One points toward two empty rounded rectangular cards on the board; the other listens with open palm. The ENTIRE board is clearly visible, including its frame and stand, with no writing. No other props.

words.example: Who has ownership of the billing service?

words.example: Maya does. Her main responsibility is keeping it reliable.

words.evidence: 职责是对白约定的工作分工，没有可定位局部。

words.example: And who will maintain the new reporting module?
words.translation: 那新的报表模块由谁来维护？

words.example: I will. Let's add both names to the board.
words.translation: 我来维护。我们把这两个名字都加到白板上吧。
words.evidence: 可定位完整白板本体；任务分工只由对白支持。

cards.title: 确认用户角色与权限
cards.description_en: A developer checks the default user role and the editing controls with a product manager.
cards.description_zh: 开发者与产品经理确认默认用户角色及编辑控件的表现。
cards.communication_goal: 确认默认权限与无编辑权限时的界面。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Which role should a new user get by default?
dialogue.zh: 新用户默认应该获得哪个角色？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Viewer. A viewer can read reports but cannot edit them.
dialogue.zh: 查看者。查看者可以阅读报表，但不能编辑。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Should the edit button disappear on the laptop screen?
dialogue.zh: 笔记本电脑屏幕上的编辑按钮应该隐藏吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Keep it visible but disabled, with a short explanation.
dialogue.zh: 保留显示，但设为不可用，并给出简短说明。

cards.title: 拆分过大的任务
cards.description_en: Two teammates split a large task into smaller independent steps on separate notes.
cards.description_zh: 两位同事把一个过大的任务拆分成较小的独立步骤，并分别记在便签上。
cards.communication_goal: 按可独立验证的步骤拆分任务。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could we split this task into smaller steps?
dialogue.zh: 我们能把这个任务拆成更小的步骤吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. Start with the API, then build the form.
dialogue.zh: 可以。先做 API，再开发表单。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are those steps independent enough to test separately?
dialogue.zh: 这些步骤是否足够独立，可以分别测试？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. I'll put each step on a separate note.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我会把每个步骤写在单独的便签上。

cards.title: 讨论异常处理策略
cards.description_en: Two developers agree on retry behavior and a fallback for a request that times out.
cards.description_zh: 两位开发者讨论请求超时后的重试方式与备用处理方案。
cards.communication_goal: 说明重试上限与失败后的用户提示。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What is our fallback if this request fails?
dialogue.zh: 这个请求失败时，我们的备用方案是什么？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: If there's a timeout, retry once before showing an error.
dialogue.zh: 如果发生超时，先重试一次，再显示错误。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Will the monitor keep showing the user's previous result?
dialogue.zh: 显示器上会继续显示用户之前的结果吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. Keep that result visible and offer a retry button.
dialogue.zh: 会的。保留那个结果，并提供一个重试按钮。

cards.title: 结对编程时交换思路
cards.description_en: A pair of developers compares approaches and switches driver and navigator roles.
cards.description_zh: 结对编程的两位开发者比较思路，并交换操作与指导角色。
cards.communication_goal: 提出另一种实现思路并交换结对角色。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could we try a different approach to this loop?
dialogue.zh: 我们能为这个循环试试另一种思路吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. I'll be the navigator while you explain your idea.
dialogue.zh: 当然。我来做指导者，你来解释你的想法。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll take the keyboard as the driver and show a small example.
dialogue.zh: 我作为操作者接过键盘，演示一个小例子。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Great. Then we'll compare the two approaches together.
dialogue.zh: 好。然后我们一起比较这两种思路。

cards.title: 提出待验证的假设
cards.description_en: Two developers test a connection hypothesis by changing a cable and checking the result.
cards.description_zh: 两位开发者通过更换连接线并检查结果，验证连接问题的假设。
cards.communication_goal: 用单一变化验证假设并隔离故障原因。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: My hypothesis is that this cable causes the connection failures.
dialogue.zh: 我的假设是这根线导致了连接失败。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Let's verify that by replacing only the cable.
dialogue.zh: 我们只更换这根线来验证一下。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: If the failures stop, can we isolate the problem to this cable?
dialogue.zh: 如果故障不再出现，我们就能把问题定位到这根线吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It's evidence for the hypothesis. Let's repeat the test before we conclude.
dialogue.zh: 这为假设提供了证据。我们先重复测试，再下结论。

cards.title: 分配事故处理职责
cards.description_en: An incident lead assigns investigation and communication tasks to teammates.
cards.description_zh: 事故负责人给同事分配排查与沟通任务。
cards.communication_goal: 明确事故期间的协调、排查和对外更新职责。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Who will coordinate our response to this incident?
dialogue.zh: 这次事故由谁协调应对？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll lead it. Please investigate the errors while I update the support team.
dialogue.zh: 我来负责。请你排查错误，我来向支持团队同步情况。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Should I use the headset to stay on the incident call?
dialogue.zh: 我应该戴上耳麦留在事故电话会议里吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. Share what you find, and I will keep the status page current.
dialogue.zh: 是的。分享你的发现，我会及时更新状态页面。

cards.title: 协商专注工作的时间
cards.description_en: A developer arranges a focus block and agrees when to be available for teammates.
cards.description_zh: 开发者安排一段专注工作时间，并与同事约定何时可以联系。
cards.communication_goal: 约定专注时间、紧急打断条件和恢复联系的时间。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could I have an hour to focus on this task?
dialogue.zh: 我能有一个小时专注处理这个任务吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. I won't interrupt you unless something urgent comes up.
dialogue.zh: 当然。除非有紧急情况，我不会打断你。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll set the timer and be available again at eleven.
dialogue.zh: 我会设置计时器，到十一点再恢复联系。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sounds good. I'll collect any questions for then.
dialogue.zh: 好。我会先把问题收集起来，到时再问。
